name: Ouroboros
description: A persistent swarm of forty-four orbiting fangs protects your head and surrounding space.

name: Serpent's Gatling
description: Rapid powerful homing fangs pierce three enemies with damage falloff.

name: Singularity Mortar
description: Bombs leave pulling damage wells. Gridlock keeps its four-turn pin and adds a well that detonates on release.

name: Hydra Brood
description: Empowered five-segment hydras carry volley damage and split into smaller brood.

name: Miasma
description: A permanent toxic aura carries your attack-speed volley and aftershock bonuses.

name: Consumption Beam
description: Always-on long-range beams preserve duration and attack-speed bonuses and consume defeated targets.

name: Shatter Fang
description: Faster critical ricochets split into three generations of chaining splinters.

name: Ancient Brood Pit
description: A powerful laser leviathan absorbs later pits and carries your attack-speed bonus.

name: Serpent's Reckoning
description: Fast grapples drag prey through enemies then devour it in a wide bite blast.
